indirect_reasons: Healbane's lower multi-source cap (4-stack 82.2%→72%) eases the anti-heal tax on her Melee Lifesteal/Restorative Shot sustain.
Rat King's buffs (bullet 5.7→5.8, ammo 24→26, T1 -25s) sharpen a hero who already beats her 62%, offsetting the Healbane relief.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing direct; Healbane relief and a stronger Rat King roughly cancel.

direct_reasons: Dazzling Trick T3 silence +1.25s→+0.75s cuts her lockdown window.
Radiant Daggers cast range 30m→25m and spirit amp +7%→+6% per stack trim her poke and scaling.
Shining Wonder slow -32%→-28%, cooldown 160s→170s, bounce 15.5m→15m, T1 -16%→-14%, T2 +90→+80 hit every axis of her ult.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's lower stacking cap gives her regen shell slight relief, but the direct cuts dominate.
build_changes: De-emphasize the ult-slow pick setup; the shorter silence and range make her dive window thinner — value Spirit Lifesteal/Torment Pulse sustain over committing on Shining Wonder.
heroes.one_liner: Every ability got trimmed at once — silence, range, ult slow and cooldown all down.

direct_reasons: Rule, Ratannia! T1 now adds -25s cooldown, partly restoring the banner uptime cut on 10-30.
Bullet damage 5.7→5.8, ammo 24→26 and +3m→+4m move speed are small stat gains.
Scrap Grenade melee fuse extension 0.4s→0.25s is a minor loss to his grenade-clear combo.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's lower multi-source cap trims anti-heal pressure on his regen stack.
build_changes: Superior/Compress Cooldown are less mandatory now that T1 covers -25s on the banner — you can spend a slot elsewhere.
heroes.one_liner: Small stat bumps plus a -25s banner cooldown talent restore some ult uptime.

direct_reasons: Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7→0.5 and melee damage per boon -10% cut her bruiser durability and damage.
Baba's Brew cooldown 27s→28s, burn spirit scaling 0.15→0.13 and cycle 1.5s→1.6s all worsen her core ability.
Granny Long Legs melee resist 30%→25% and debuff resist 30%→25% thin her frontline shell.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's lower 4-stack cap is a small relief for her regen wall, but the kit cuts dominate.
build_changes: The resist-scaling cut makes the regen/bruiser shell weaker — lean further into the cooldown caster line and treat her as a caster, not a frontline.
heroes.one_liner: Resist scaling, melee damage and Brew all trimmed — the bruiser shell is thinner.

indirect_reasons: Baba and Celeste — two of his three worst lanes — both ate broad nerfs.
Rat King, his worst lane, got buffed (bullet 5.7→5.8, T1 -25s), offsetting that relief.
heroes.one_liner: Two bad matchups weakened, one strengthened — net roughly flat.

direct_reasons: Close The Deal bonus damage to under-half targets +75%→+55% cuts his execute.
Strix Salvo spirit scaling -8% lowers his mark damage.
Chimera Mk1 T2 heal 150→125 and heal spirit scaling 2.0→1.7 trim his dive sustain.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's lower stacking cap is minor relief for a flyer with no real sustain shell.
build_changes: With the execute and mark scaling down, the spirit mark-burst line loses payoff — value the defensive glue (Reactive Barrier, Grit) more and pick fights only on already-chipped targets.
heroes.one_liner: Execute and mark damage both cut — his dive converts fewer kills.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's lower multi-source cap eases the anti-heal tax on her Radiant/Mystic Regeneration shell.
Baba, a 41% loss for her, was nerfed across her kit.
Rat King, another 41% loss, got buffed — offsets the relief.
heroes.one_liner: Healbane relief and a weaker Baba help her regen shell slightly.

direct_reasons: Bullet damage +8% lifts the gun-damage charge economy her sustain build runs on.
Lurking Terrors fear buildup 2s→1.75s and vertical angle 50%→65% widen and speed the fear cone.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's lower stacking cap slightly relieves anti-heal on her healing-based sustain.
build_changes: The wider, faster fear cone rewards the mag-dump gun line more than before — keep Titanic Magazine core and lean into the gun-damage charge.
heroes.one_liner: Gun damage up and a faster, wider fear cone — small but real gains.
